summary.business_type: Local service (in-person golf coaching, single location)
top_findings: Mobile performance is poor (62/100, LCP 6.5s) versus desktop (90/100, LCP 1.5s) — the one real problem on an otherwise strong site
Two quantified WCAG color-contrast failures: brass-dark on ivory (4.33:1 vs 4.5:1 required), bone-mute on fairway (3.58:1 vs 4.5:1 required)
Heading hierarchy breaks in the footer — h2 to h4 with no h3 anywhere on the page
New logo images lack explicit width/height attributes (CLS risk)
FAQPage schema is correct but won't earn a Google rich snippet (policy restriction since Aug 2023, not a defect)
quick_wins: Load Google Fonts stylesheet non-blocking (~800ms mobile LCP improvement)
Darken brass-dark / lighten bone-mute slightly to pass contrast
Change footer h4 column headings to h3
Add explicit width/height to logo img tags
Add explicit Cache-Control headers for /assets and /images in vercel.json

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: robots.txt with explicit AI crawler allowlist and sitemap directive
sitemap.xml with all 9 routes and lastmod dates
Per-page canonical URLs
Security headers (HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy)
Clean URL structure
Verified prerendering solution built for the SPA JS-rendering gap (not yet wired into live build)
404 page tagged noindex
IndexNow verification key present

findings.title: No explicit cache headers for static assets
findings.description: vercel.json's headers block covers security only; caching relies on unverified Vercel platform defaults.
findings.recommendation: Add Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable for /assets/(.*) and /images/(.*).

findings.title: Render-blocking Google Fonts request
findings.description: Confirmed via Lighthouse render-blocking-insight: fonts.googleapis.com CSS blocks first paint for ~827ms under mobile throttling.
findings.recommendation: Switch to async stylesheet loading pattern (media=print onload swap, or equivalent).

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Real, specific, non-generic copy across every page
Genuine E-E-A-T signals: PGA credential, first-person bio with specific history, named location, real contact details
Genuine FAQ content reused directly for FAQPage schema
Specific, plausible testimonials

findings.title: No topical depth beyond core service pages
findings.description: No blog or long-form content answering adjacent questions; fine for core pages but limits long-tail/AI-answer-engine reach.
findings.recommendation: Consider secondary content if organic growth beyond branded search becomes a goal.

findings.title: No aggregate review rating
findings.description: Correctly not fabricated in schema. Real reviews would strengthen trust signals and local pack ranking.
findings.recommendation: Claim/optimize Google Business Profile; add AggregateRating schema once real reviews exist.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Unique title/meta description per page via a shared SEO component
Unique, keyword-relevant H1s per page
Internal linking between related service pages
BreadcrumbList schema on every sub-page

findings.title: Heading hierarchy breaks in the footer
findings.description: Home.jsx/ui.jsx go h1->h2->h3->h2->h2->h2; Footer.jsx uses h4 for nav-column headings with no h3 anywhere before it in the document.
findings.recommendation: Change Footer.jsx's two <h4> column headings to <h3>.

findings.title: Two WCAG color-contrast failures
findings.description: brass-dark (#8f6c3a) on ivory (#f6f3ec) = 4.33:1 (needs 4.5:1); bone-mute (#928f84) on fairway (#263e2e) = 3.58:1 (needs 4.5:1). Quantified via axe-core through Lighthouse.
findings.recommendation: Darken brass-dark slightly for text-on-ivory use; lighten bone-mute for text-on-fairway use.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: LocalBusiness with full NAP, GeoCoordinates, areaServed, founder, and service catalog, verified consistent with visible page content
Service schema on Lessons/Fitting/Membership, each referencing the business via @id
FAQPage schema generated directly from the same data that renders visibly (no drift risk)
BreadcrumbList on every sub-page, Person schema on About

findings.title: FAQPage won't earn a Google rich snippet
findings.description: Google restricted this rich result to authoritative gov/health/well-known sites in Aug 2023. Schema is still valid and useful for AI answer engines.
findings.recommendation: No action needed — this is expectation-setting, not a defect.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Desktop Lighthouse Performance: 90, LCP 1.5s, TBT 0ms
CLS 0 on both desktop and mobile — the scroll-reveal animation system does not cause layout shift

findings.title: Mobile performance is poor
findings.description: Mobile Lighthouse Performance: 62, LCP 6.5s, Speed Index 6.0s (real lab data, v13.5.0). Driven primarily by a render-blocking Google Fonts request (~827ms), reCAPTCHA's script (353KB, 63% unused), and an unsplit single JS bundle (42% unused per page).
findings.recommendation: Load fonts non-blocking first (biggest single lever); wire up prerendering; consider route-based code-splitting if the bundle grows.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: llms.txt present following the llmstxt.org spec, with business summary and page links
robots.txt explicitly names every major AI crawler as allowed
Genuine FAQ content in clean Q&A format — good passage-level citability
Structured data gives AI crawlers unambiguous entity info

findings.title: No citation-worthy aggregate statistics
findings.description: LaunchMonitor numbers are illustrative example data, not real claimed outcomes.
findings.recommendation: Add real aggregate stats (e.g. member outcome data) if/when available — strong AI-citation material.

categories.name: Images
what_works: All photos converted PNG to JPEG at quality 82, ~86% total weight reduction, no visible quality loss
Descriptive, specific alt text throughout

findings.title: Logo images missing explicit width/height
findings.description: The two new SCG logo tags (Navbar, Footer) are sized via Tailwind classes only, not HTML width/height attributes. Lighthouse flags this as a CLS risk.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit width/height attributes matching the 837:447 aspect ratio.

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Load Google Fonts non-blocking (biggest mobile LCP lever)
Wire prerendering into the live Vercel build once verified on a preview

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Add explicit width/height to logo images
Add explicit Cache-Control headers for static assets
Consider route-based code-splitting if bundle grows

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Claim/optimize Google Business Profile once live
Add AggregateRating schema once real reviews exist
Re-run this audit after font/prerendering fixes land
Consider secondary long-tail content if organic growth becomes a goal
